title: Rigidity of a closed-fibre approximation through a flat local algebra
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$, $(T,\mathfrak m_T)$, $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ and $(C,\mathfrak m_C)$ be nonzero commutative local rings with local homomorphisms $a:R\to T$, $u:T\to B$ and $v:B\to C$, where local means that the maximal ideal of the source maps into that of the target. Give $B,C$ their $R$-algebra structures through this tower. Assume that $T$ and $C$ are essentially of finite presentation over $R$, meaning each is isomorphic as an $R$-algebra to a localization of a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra, def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Assume $u$ is surjective and induces an isomorphism $\bar u:T/\mathfrak m_RT\xrightarrow{\sim}B/\mathfrak m_RB$, $[t]\mapsto[u(t)]$. Assume $C$ is flat over $R$ and $C/\mathfrak m_RC$ is flat over $B/\mathfrak m_RB$ for the action induced by $v$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Here $\mathfrak m_R D$ means the ideal generated by the image of $\mathfrak m_R$ in $D=T,B,C$. Then $T$ is flat over $R$, $C$ is flat over $T$ via $v\circ u$, and $u:T\to B$ is an isomorphism of $R$-algebras. No finite-presentation or flatness hypothesis on $B$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 05UV, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre-fp-over-ft, application of Tag 00R7, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre, to the finitely presented approximation; structure-sheaf specialization completed with Tag 00HR, algebra-lemma-local-flat-ff, and Tag 05CK, algebra-lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective.

proof.text: Put $A=T/\mathfrak m_RT$, $D=B/\mathfrak m_RB$, and $N=C/\mathfrak m_RC$. The given isomorphism $\bar u:A\cong D$ makes the $A$-action on $N$ exactly the restriction of its given $D$-action: $[t][c]=[v(u(t))c]$. An injective map of $A$-modules is, via $\bar u^{-1}$, the same injective map of $D$-modules, and its tensor product with $N$ is the same map: the balancing relations agree under $\bar u$. Thus flatness of $N$ over $D$ implies flatness over $A$ by [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Tag 05UV, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre-fp-over-ft, closed-fibre isomorphism before the application of Tag 00R7; flatness is Definition Tag 00HB, algebra-definition-flat.

proof.text: Let $w=v\circ u:T\to C$. It is local since $u(\mathfrak m_T)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$ and $v(\mathfrak m_B)\subseteq\mathfrak m_C$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-criterion-flatness-fibre] with its $S=T$, $S'=C$ and $M=C$, and maps $a,w$. Both required essential finite presentations are hypotheses. As a module over itself, $C$ has the finite presentation $C=\operatorname{coker}(0\to C)$, and $C\ne0$ is assumed. Its quotient $M/\mathfrak m_RM$ is $N$, flat over $T/\mathfrak m_RT$ by step 1; its $R$-flatness is the other given flatness hypothesis. The criterion therefore gives both $T$ flat over $R$ and $C$ flat over $T$.

source.place: Tag 00R7, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre; Tag 05UV, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre-fp-over-ft, application to the finitely presented approximation.

proof.text: The map $w:T\to C$ is now a flat local homomorphism of local rings. Consequently [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat] makes $w$ faithfully flat.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-universally-injective] to $w$ and the $T$-module $T$. It makes $t\mapsto t\otimes1$ injective. The isomorphism $T\otimes_TC\cong C$ sends $t\otimes c$ to $w(t)c$, with inverse $c\mapsto1\otimes c$; the two composites are identities by the balancing relation. Hence $w$ is injective. If $u(t)=0$, then $w(t)=v(0)=0$, so $t=0$. Thus $u$ is injective as well as surjective, and is a ring isomorphism. It is an $R$-algebra isomorphism because $u(a(r))$ is the specified $R$-structure on $B$; its inverse sends this element back to $a(r)$. Together with step 2 this proves every conclusion.

source.place: Tag 05CK, algebra-lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective, specialized to the source ring as module; elementary kernel argument for the factorization.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05UV, algebra-lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre-fp-over-ft, application of Tag 00R7 to the approximation, with the structure-module specialization and Tags 00HR and 05CK.

The statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to the Q61 copy, where the item was unsplit; there are no new nodes and no SGA citations. Step 1 is genuinely elementary: the A-action on N via w is the D-action pulled back along the ring isomorphism ū, and flatness survives that restriction. Step 2 applies 00R7 with S=T, S'=C, M=C, and all five hypotheses hold: T and C are essentially fp with C's R-structure equal to w∘a; C=coker(0→C) is finitely presented; C≠0; N is flat over T/m_RT by step 1; C is R-flat. B is never used as the middle ring, so no fp hypothesis on B is needed. Step 3: w is flat and local, so faithfully flat by 00HR. Step 4: 05CK with N=T, composed with T⊗_TC≅C, gives w injective, hence u injective; with surjectivity u is an R-algebra isomorphism. The route replaces the source's mod-injective-general step with faithful flatness, which is valid because M is the ring C itself. Edge cases: R a field; R=k[ε]/(ε²), T=R, B=C=k is excluded by R-flatness of C; C=0 is excluded by the nonzero hypothesis. proof_deps equals the union of the uses. lem-weil-pbc-flat-closed-fibre-kernel-rigidity (Noetherian T, kernel formula) is not a duplicate. The only citer, lem-sfb-fibrewise-flatness-criterion step 3, uses exactly the unchanged statement.
